claim: Figshare is an external research repository infrastructure provider for sharing, showcasing, and managing research outputs in discoverable and citable forms.
future_grounding_route: Figshare records can seed acquisition only after file availability, license, metadata, and biological relevance are inspected and project-hashed.
project_use: Supplementary-data discovery route for papers and datasets not deposited in GEO/ENA/EGA.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: General-purpose paper-linked and institutional research outputs, including datasets and non-traditional supplementary materials.
why_unverifiable: Figshare deposits are externally managed and heterogeneous; individual records require project intake before use.
